entities.summary: Yuriy Orest Ivanovych Tarnawsky was a Ukrainian-American writer and linguist, one of the founding members of the New York Group of Poets, a group of avant-garde Ukrainian diaspora writers, co-founder and co-editor of the journal New Poetry, as well as a member of the US innovative writers' collaborative Fiction Collective. He wrote fiction, poetry, plays, translations, and criticism in both Ukrainian and English.
